company.name: Array Labs
company.shortDescription: Array Labs designs and operates space-based radar systems and delivers 3D Earth imagery and geospatial data services.
company.description: Array Labs designs and operates space-based radar systems and delivers 3D Earth imagery and geospatial data services. The company develops modular radar payloads and distributed radar satellite clusters that capture multi-angle data to generate detailed three-dimensional models of terrestrial surfaces and objects. It provides standalone radar instruments for integration on satellite platforms, fully integrated satellite systems for customers that require dedicated sensing assets, and processed 3D data products via APIs or delivery channels. Array Labs also works with partners to support simulation and modeling of distributed radar constellations and to co-develop enriched datasets that combine radar and other sensing modalities. Its offerings support applications such as geospatial intelligence, infrastructure monitoring, and analytical workflows reliant on volumetric surface data.

aiResearchSummary.text: Array Labs is researching a space-based distributed radar system for facilitating imaging of areas, as described in a method and system for a space-based distributed radar system for facilitating imaging of areas. Using a satellite cluster that flies in coordinated formation, the system enables imaging of terrestrial regions from orbit. Collectively, these efforts focus on distributed space radar architectures and orbital imaging system design.
